paper_title: Spectral Editing of Activations for Large Language Model Alignment
caption: : Left: Accuracy of all methods on each group of bias type in BBQ. Right: results on BBQ's testing set. All methods are applied on LLaMA-2-Chat-7B. For accuracy (A%_{}), higher values are better; for unknown-answer response rate (U%_{}), bias score (BS%_{}) and stereotypical response rate (SR%_{}), lower is better. We use bold font for the best result in each column, and mark the methods that improve ICL. : significant improvements on ICL in A% by pair-wise t-test with p < 0.05.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the accuracy of several methods – Linear SAE, LLaMA-2-chat-7B, and ICD (Prompt version) – when applied to different types of bias in the BBQ dataset. The x-axis represents the number of demonstrations, ranging from 0 to 2000, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 500. The y-axis, labeled “MC1”, uses a linear scale and spans from approximately 37 to 40, with units unspecified but likely representing a measurement of accuracy. The Linear SAE line is depicted as solid blue circles, beginning at a value around 38 and increasing to approximately 40 at the end of the x-axis. The LLaMA-2-chat-7B line is shown as a dashed pink line starting at approximately 38 and also rising to around 40. Finally, the ICD line is indicated by a dotted blue line, beginning around 37 and increasing to approximately 39 at the end of the x-axis.
